outlineVi: Mở đầu: Giới thiệu đó là quảng cáo về cái gì (ví dụ: một chiến dịch nâng cao an toàn giao thông), xem ở đâu và vào thời gian nào.
Ý 1: Thuật lại kịch bản quảng cáo (tình huống kịch tính, cách thời gian ngưng đọng và cuộc trò chuyện giữa hai tài xế trước vụ va chạm).
Ý 2: Miêu tả cảm xúc khi xem (ấn tượng mạnh bởi tính nhân văn, hình ảnh chân thực và không dùng chiêu trò giật gân rẻ tiền).
Kết: Lý giải vì sao nó khó phai trong tâm trí (thông điệp sâu sắc về trách nhiệm cá nhân, thay đổi hành vi lái xe của bản thân).
advertising.sample:
I would like to talk about an unforgettable public service commercial about road safety that I encountered a couple of years ago on YouTube. It was launched by a transport authority to deter reckless speeding.

The advert depicted a split-second right before a horrific head-on collision between two vehicles. Miraculously, time froze, allowing both motorists to step out and talk. One driver remorsefully admitted he had misjudged the intersection, while the other pleaded that his young boy was in the back seat and there was no time to brake. After realizing the collision was unavoidable, they silently stepped back inside, and time resumed with a devastating impact.

What made this commercial exceptionally memorable was its emotional gravity and masterful storytelling. Instead of relying on gratuitous gore or cheap shock tactics, it focused purely on human vulnerability and regret. It powerfully conveyed that a momentary lapse in concentration can irreversibly destroy innocent lives. That haunting scene genuinely changed my driving habits, constantly reminding me to remain vigilant whenever I take the wheel.

p1.q: Do you often see advertisements when you browse the internet?
p1.a: Constantly, to be honest. Whenever I scroll through Instagram feeds or read digital newspapers, targeted banners and sponsored posts appear everywhere. For instance, right after researching wireless headphones, related ads instantly flooded my screen.

p1.q: Have you ever bought something directly because of an advert?
p1.a: Yes, on a few occasions. A while back, I purchased an ergonomic desk chair after seeing a persuasive video clip on TikTok explaining its lumbar support benefits. Fortunately, the product actually lived up to its promises.

p1.q: What kind of advertisements do you find most annoying?
p1.a: I thoroughly detest unskippable video ads that abruptly disrupt music streams or instructional videos. They completely break my concentration and, paradoxically, make me develop an aversion toward whatever brand is being aggressively promoted.

p3.q: In what ways has digital advertising transformed consumer behavior in recent years?
p3.a: Digital advertising has fostered a culture of immediate gratification. Through sophisticated algorithms and frictionless one-click purchasing, marketing messages now induce frequent impulse buying rather than calculated shopping. For example, personalized promotions on social media nudge individuals toward acquiring products they never originally intended to possess. Consequently, modern consumption has noticeably transitioned from being strictly necessity-driven to predominantly emotionally charged.

p3.q: Should governments introduce stricter regulations on advertisements aimed at children?
p3.a: Definitely, as young minds lack the critical faculties required to distinguish promotional hyperbole from reality. Unchecked commercials promoting sugary confectionery or violent merchandise frequently distort children's dietary habits and behavioral patterns. While businesses might lament the loss of commercial freedom, safeguarding child well-being must always take precedence over corporate profits. Therefore, enacting strict bans on deceptive promotional tactics targeting minors is thoroughly justified.

mistakesVi: Lặp đi lặp lại danh từ 'advertisement' thay vì sử dụng đa dạng các từ như 'commercial', 'billboard', 'sponsored content', hoặc 'ad campaign'.
Dùng sai kết hợp từ phổ biến, chẳng hạn nói 'make an advertisement' thay vì 'run an ad' hay 'launch an advertising campaign'.
Phát âm sai trọng âm của từ 'advertisement' (chuẩn Anh-Anh là /ədˈvɜː.tɪs.mənt/, chuẩn Anh-Mỹ là /ˌæd.vɚˈtaɪz.mənt/), dẫn đến việc ấp úng mất điểm phát âm.

outlineVi: Mở đầu: Giới thiệu ngắn gọn tác phẩm bạn muốn nhắc đến (tranh sơn dầu 'Bình minh trên ruộng bậc thang', tình cờ thấy trong một triển lãm nhỏ tại Hà Nội).
Ý 1: Mô tả diện mạo tác phẩm (gam màu vàng óng và xanh ngọc, lớp sương sớm mờ ảo, nét vẽ gồ ghề tạo chiều sâu chân thực).
Ý 2: Nêu thông tin về tác giả và bối cảnh (một họa sĩ địa phương tên Hoàng Vũ, khắc họa vẻ đẹp thiên nhiên vùng cao phía Bắc).
Kết: Giải thích lý do để lại ấn tượng sâu sắc (mang lại cảm giác an yên giữa phố thị ồn ào, khơi dậy tình yêu với cảnh sắc quê hương).
art.sample: I'd like to share an encounter with a mesmerizing piece of art that truly stood out to me. It is an oil painting titled 'Dawn over the Terraces', created by a local contemporary painter named Hoang Vu. I stumbled upon it about two years ago while exploring a cozy art boutique in downtown Hanoi. Visually, the canvas captures the cascading rice terraces of northern Vietnam right at sunrise. It is dominated by a rich palette of golden yellows and lush emerald greens, contrasted by the soft, diffused morning mist drifting between the valleys. What captivated me most was the artist's textured brushwork; you could almost feel the cool morning dew and the gentle breeze sweeping across the fields. The reason this painting left such an indelible mark on me is the overwhelming sense of serenity it conveyed. Living in a bustling, high-stress city, standing before that artwork felt like an emotional retreat. It wasn't merely a technical triumph with intricate detail, but a thought-provoking celebration of rural tranquility that instantly lowered my heart rate and made me appreciate the simple beauty of nature.

p1.q: Do you enjoy visiting art galleries or exhibitions?
p1.a: Honestly, yes. I find wandering through exhibitions quite therapeutic, as it offers a creative escape from daily routines. Just last month, I visited an impressionist gallery, and the dynamic use of light totally fascinated me.

p1.q: Did you learn how to draw or paint when you were a child?
p1.a: Yes, we had mandatory art classes in primary school where we sketched basic objects like fruits and landscapes. Although I lacked natural talent, mixing watercolors was always the highlight of my week.

p1.q: Do you have any artwork displayed on the walls of your home?
p1.a: We do have a couple of minimalist canvas prints in our living room. They feature abstract geometric patterns that complement our modern furniture and bring a welcoming, aesthetic vibe to the entire space.

p3.q: Why do some people consider traditional art forms more valuable than digital artwork?
p3.a: I think traditional art is often seen as more authentic because it requires physical mastery of tangible materials, like canvas and clay. Each piece is unique and impossible to replicate identically. In contrast, digital art can be duplicated with a single click, which sometimes diminishes its perceived rarity. Consequently, collectors are willing to pay a premium for physical works that represent irreversible craftsmanship.

p3.q: Should governments allocate significant public funds to support artists and cultural institutions?
p3.a: Without question, government funding is essential for preserving a nation's cultural heritage and fostering creativity. While some argue that public money should prioritize healthcare or infrastructure, art institutions enrich society spiritually and attract tourism. Without state subsidies, independent artists would struggle to survive financially, potentially leading to the decline of traditional cultural expressions that define national identity.

mistakesVi: Lạm dụng từ 'picture' để chỉ mọi tác phẩm nghệ thuật; nên dùng từ vựng chính xác hơn như 'painting' (tranh vẽ màu), 'sketch' (bản phác thảo), 'portrait' (chân dung) hay 'sculpture' (tác phẩm điêu khắc).
Nhầm lẫn giữa tính từ 'artistic' (có tính nghệ thuật, khéo léo) và 'artificial' (nhân tạo, không tự nhiên).
Cố ép bản thân dùng thuật ngữ chuyên môn quá hàn lâm (như chiaroscuro, cubism) khi chưa hiểu sâu, dẫn đến ấp úng; thay vào đó hãy mô tả màu sắc, đường nét và cảm xúc cá nhân một cách tự nhiên.

birthdays.sample: I would like to share the story of an exceptionally meaningful birthday present I received on my eighteenth birthday. It was a handcrafted photo scrapbook compiled by my childhood best friend, Linh. Inside, she had meticulously assembled photographs documenting our friendship from primary school right through high school, accompanied by handwritten anecdotes and inside jokes we had shared over the years. When she handed it to me wrapped in rustic brown paper, I had anticipated a standard shop-bought item, so uncovering this labor of love took me completely by surprise. In fact, flipping through the pages made me tear up because it revived so many forgotten memories. What made this keepsake irreplaceable was its immense sentimental value. Turning eighteen felt daunting as we were about to head to different universities, but this album served as a tangible reminder of our enduring bond. In an era where digital messages and mass-produced goods dominate, knowing someone dedicated weeks to crafting something personal just for me was profoundly touching. It remains the most precious birthday gift I have ever received.

p1.q: How do you usually celebrate your birthday?
p1.a: I generally opt for a low-key celebration with my immediate family and closest friends. Typically, we prepare a hearty home-cooked meal and share a cake, as I find intimate gatherings much more meaningful than throwing noisy parties.

p1.q: What kind of gifts do you prefer receiving from your close friends?
p1.a: I definitely appreciate personalized or experiential presents rather than expensive items. For instance, a thoughtful book picked specifically for my reading tastes or concert tickets to a shared favorite band holds far greater significance for me.

p1.q: Do you think it is difficult to choose a suitable present for someone?
p1.a: Yes, it can be quite challenging because balancing someone's distinct preferences with practicality requires effort. Unless you know the recipient deeply, there is always a lingering risk of gifting something redundant that ends up unused in a drawer.

p3.q: In what ways has the way people celebrate birthdays evolved compared to previous generations?
p3.a: In the past, birthday festivities in Vietnam were modest occasions centered strictly around family meals and home cooking. Today, influenced heavily by social media culture and higher disposable income, celebrations have grown noticeably lavish. Young people frequently hire aesthetic venues, curate themed parties, or travel abroad. While this encourages creative expression, it sometimes shifts the focus from authentic bonding toward staging pictures for online validation.

p3.q: Do you believe commercialization has diminished the genuine sentimental value of giving presents?
p3.a: To a certain extent, yes. Aggressive corporate advertising often equates genuine affection with exorbitant price tags, pressuring consumers into buying luxury goods simply to conform to social expectations. Nevertheless, sentimental value has not vanished entirely. Many individuals still prioritize hand-crafted or uniquely personalized tokens of appreciation, demonstrating that genuine emotional intent continues to outweigh pure monetary cost.

mistakesVi: Lặp từ vựng đơn điệu 'gift' và 'present' xuyên suốt bài mà không sử dụng các từ thay thế linh hoạt như 'token of appreciation', 'keepsake', hoặc 'personalized memento'.
Dịch từng từ tiếng Việt sang tiếng Anh không tự nhiên, chẳng hạn dùng 'open a party' thay vì các collocation chuẩn như 'throw a party' hoặc 'host a gathering'.
Nhầm lẫn thì động từ khi nói về trải nghiệm nhận quà trong quá khứ, ví dụ dùng hiện tại hoàn thành 'I have received it when I was 15' thay vì quá khứ đơn 'I received it when I was 15'.

outlineVi: Mở đầu: Giới thiệu diễn viên Keanu Reeves và nêu rõ vị thế ngôi sao quốc tế của ông.
Ý 1: Nêu bật các tác phẩm điện ảnh kinh điển làm nên tên tuổi như The Matrix và John Wick.
Ý 2: Miêu tả việc ông âm thầm lập quỹ hỗ trợ bệnh nhi ung thư và luôn đối xử tử tế với đoàn làm phim.
Kết: Bày tỏ sự khâm phục đối với lối sống khiêm nhường, không màng hào nhoáng và tấm lòng nhân ái của ông.
celebrities.sample:
I would like to talk about Keanu Reeves, a world-renowned Canadian actor whom I truly look up to. He is best known for his stellar roles in blockbuster franchises like The Matrix and John Wick, establishing himself as an undeniable household name across the globe.

Despite his immense fame and fortune, Keanu leads a remarkably modest lifestyle. What impresses me most is how he consistently uses his platform for the greater good. Having experienced severe personal tragedy, he quietly established a private charitable foundation that funds cancer research and children's hospitals, deliberately keeping his name off the organization to avoid media attention. Furthermore, there are countless documented stories of him treating film crews with genuine kindness and taking pay cuts so that crew members could receive fair compensation.

I admire him immensely because he redefines what it means to be a celebrity. In an industry often dominated by vanity and sensational media circuses, he remains remarkably grounded and generous. His humility and empathy serve as a refreshing reminder that true influence comes from how you treat others rather than the glamour of fame.

p1.q: Do you follow any famous people on social media?
p1.a: Yes, I follow a few tech innovators and professional athletes on Instagram. For instance, I follow Cristiano Ronaldo because his daily workout routines and relentless discipline keep me motivated to stay fit.

p1.q: Who was your favorite celebrity when you were a child?
p1.a: When I was younger, I was a massive fan of Jackie Chan. I loved his action-comedy films like Rush Hour because his stunt work was thrilling yet genuinely hilarious to watch.

p1.q: Would you like to be famous in the future?
p1.a: Not really, because I deeply value my personal privacy. Being constantly scrutinized in the public eye seems overwhelming, and I would much rather achieve quiet professional success without unwanted media attention.

p3.q: Do you think celebrities have a moral responsibility to be positive role models for young people?
p3.a: I believe they do, to a certain extent. Because celebrities possess massive cultural influence, impressionable teenagers often emulate their behavior, fashion, and values. For instance, when a pop star promotes mental health awareness, it can destigmatize seeking therapy for thousands. However, we should not expect them to be flawless saints, as they are ultimately ordinary human beings under intense pressure.

p3.q: How has social media changed the relationship between public figures and their fans?
p3.a: Social media has fundamentally bridged the gap between stars and their audience. In the past, famous people were distant and mysterious, accessible only through television or magazines. Nowadays, platforms like TikTok and Instagram allow celebrities to share unedited moments of their daily lives, creating a sense of intimacy. However, this hyper-accessibility can also fuel unhealthy parasocial relationships and toxic online harassment.

mistakesVi: Lạm dụng từ 'celebrity' lặp lại liên tục thay vì dùng các từ đồng nghĩa tự nhiên như 'public figures', 'icons', 'well-known personalities' hoặc 'stars'.
Dịch chay cụm từ tiếng Việt sang tiếng Anh thiếu tự nhiên, ví dụ nói 'make scandal' thay vì các cách diễn đạt chuẩn như 'be embroiled in a scandal' hoặc 'cause public controversy'.
Dành quá nhiều thời gian liệt kê tiểu sử chi tiết (năm sinh, quê quán, danh sách tác phẩm) mà quên phân tích quan điểm cá nhân và tác động xã hội theo yêu cầu của đề bài.

outlineVi: Mở đầu: Giới thiệu ngắn gọn về trò thả diều vào mỗi buổi chiều hè tại cánh đồng ven ngoại ô thị trấn.
Ý 1 (Ở đâu & Với ai): Bối cảnh bãi cỏ rộng lộng gió sau giờ tan học và nhóm bạn cùng xóm tự vót nan tre làm diều.
Ý 2 (Hoạt động diễn ra thế nào): Kể chi tiết cảm giác chạy đón gió, thi nhau kéo dây để diều bay cao vút trên nền trời hoàng hôn.
Kết (Lý do ấn tượng sâu sắc): Khẳng định hoạt động không màn hình ảo này rèn luyện sự khéo léo, gắn kết tình bạn và là biểu tượng của tuổi thơ vô tư.
childhood.sample: I'd like to talk about kite flying, an outdoor pastime that defined my childhood summers. Back in the early 2000s, my family lived near an expansive meadow on the outskirts of our town. Every breezy late afternoon, a bunch of neighborhood kids and I would dash out there after finishing our homework. We actually fashioned our own kites out of bamboo strips, old newspapers, and cooked rice paste, which made the experience even more rewarding. We would sprint against the wind, tugging the strings frantically until the kites soared high into the twilight sky. It was utterly thrilling to watch our homemade creations glide above the open fields. This activity left an indelible mark on me because it was completely free from digital distractions. It taught me patience and manual dexterity, as making the kite balance properly was no easy feat. More importantly, those carefree afternoons forged unbreakable bonds between us, and whenever I spot a kite fluttering today, it instantly transports me back to those halcyon days of pure innocence.

p1.q: Did you enjoy your childhood?
p1.a: Definitely, yes. I had an exceptionally joyful upbringing surrounded by loving relatives and lively neighborhood peers. We spent most afternoons playing outdoors until sunset, which gave me countless sweet memories that I still cherish today.

p1.q: What was your favourite game to play when you were younger?
p1.a: I was head over heels for hide-and-seek. My friends and I would scout out every nook and cranny in our apartment complex, and the sheer thrill of evading detection made it an irresistible daily ritual.

p1.q: Who was your closest friend during your primary school years?
p1.a: That would be Minh, my next-door neighbor. We sat at the same desk in class and shared virtually everything, from comic books to secret snacks, forming a genuine bond that lasted all the way through high school.

p3.q: How have children's leisure activities changed compared to several decades ago?
p3.a: In the past, children's pastimes were largely outdoors and community-oriented, revolving around spontaneous physical games like tag or skipping rope. In contrast, modern youngsters gravitate toward solitary screen time, such as playing video games or streaming videos on tablets. While this shift certainly enhances tech literacy from an early age, it unfortunately deprives kids of valuable physical exercise and organic social interaction with their peers.

p3.q: To what extent does a person's childhood environment shape their adult personality?
p3.a: I firmly believe childhood circumstances lay the groundwork for adulthood. Growing up in a secure, supportive household typically fosters emotional stability and self-confidence, whereas enduring prolonged adversity or neglect might lead to chronic anxiety later in life. Of course, adult experiences and conscious self-development can reshape one's outlook, but the behavioral patterns established during one's formative years undeniably remain the bedrock of adult identity.

mistakesVi: Lạm dụng thì hiện tại đơn khi kể chuyện quá khứ: Người học hay quên chia động từ ở thì quá khứ đơn (V2/-ed) hoặc thiếu sự luân chuyển tự nhiên với 'used to' và 'would' khi nói về thói quen cũ.
Dùng sai từ vựng thành 'childhood memorial': 'Memorial' mang nghĩa là đài tưởng niệm hoặc công trình tưởng niệm; để chỉ kỷ niệm thời thơ ấu, bạn cần dùng danh từ 'memories' hoặc 'recollections'.
Mô tả cảm xúc quá chung chung: Thí sinh thường lặp đi lặp lại 'I was very happy' thay vì dùng các tính từ gợi tả trạng thái tinh thần sâu sắc hơn như 'carefree', 'blissful' hay 'nostalgic'.

Ý 1: Tóm tắt ngắn gọn bối cảnh và tuyến nhân vật chính (Chris Gardner do Will Smith thủ vai, người cha đơn thân đối mặt cảnh vô gia cư khi nuôi con).
Ý 2: Nêu những điểm đắt giá nhất trong trải nghiệm xem (diễn xuất chân thực, mối liên kết xúc động giữa hai cha con, hành trình thực tập không lương gian nan).
Kết: Phân tích lý do phim để lại dấu ấn sâu sắc (bài học đắt giá về sự bền bỉ vượt nghịch cảnh, nguồn động lực to lớn mỗi khi bản thân gặp bế tắc).
cinema.sample:
I'd like to talk about an uplifting biographical drama called 'The Pursuit of Happyness', which left a profound mark on me. I first stumbled upon it on Netflix a couple of years ago during a particularly stressful exam period.

The film revolves around Chris Gardner, played brilliantly by Will Smith, a struggling salesman facing homelessness while trying to raise his young son all by himself. Despite facing relentless setbacks and financial despair, he secures an unpaid internship at a competitive brokerage firm, pinning all his hopes on a better future.

What resonated with me most was the raw authenticity of the performances. The emotional bond between father and son felt genuine and heartwarming. This movie made such an indelible impression on me because it wasn't just entertaining; it served as a masterclass in resilience. Whenever I feel overwhelmed by life's hurdles, I remind myself of Chris's determination, which reinforces my belief that perseverance can turn even the darkest circumstances around.

p1.q: How often do you go to the cinema to watch a movie?
p1.a: I usually go once or twice a month, typically on weekends with friends. We love catching newly released blockbusters on the big screen because the surround sound and visual quality are unmatched at home.

p1.q: What genre of films do you usually prefer watching?
p1.a: I am particularly fond of psychological thrillers. I enjoy complex plot twists that challenge my deduction skills, and movies like 'Inception' or 'Shutter Island' always keep me hooked right until the closing credits.

p1.q: Did you enjoy watching movies when you were a child?
p1.a: Yes, definitely. As a kid, I was obsessed with animated movies, especially Disney classics like 'The Lion King'. My parents used to reward me with a movie night whenever I got good grades at school.

p3.q: Why do some people still prefer watching films in theaters rather than on streaming platforms?
p3.a: In my opinion, going to the theater offers an immersive audiovisual spectacle that home streaming simply cannot replicate. Giant IMAX screens and acoustic engineering create a sensory experience where viewers can truly escape reality. Furthermore, cinema outings provide a communal atmosphere, sharing collective gasps and laughter with strangers, which makes the whole viewing experience far more memorable.

p3.q: To what extent can films influence people's moral values and worldview?
p3.a: I believe cinema exerts a profound influence on shaping cultural perceptions and empathy. By presenting diverse narratives and ethical dilemmas, films expose viewers to realities beyond their immediate circles. For instance, socially conscious movies can alter public attitudes towards prejudice or mental health. However, audiences with firm principles might remain unaffected, meaning cinema often reinforces existing convictions rather than completely transforming them.

mistakesVi: Lạm dụng việc tóm tắt toàn bộ cốt truyện (plot summary) quá chi tiết trong Part 2 thay vì tập trung vào cảm xúc cá nhân, kỹ thuật làm phim và lý do tác phẩm gây ấn tượng.

Nhầm lẫn từ vựng cơ bản như dùng lẫn lộn giữa 'character' (nhân vật hư cấu) và 'actor' (diễn viên ngoài đời), hoặc lặp đi lặp lại từ 'film'/'movie' mà không đổi sang 'picture', 'motion picture' hay 'flick'.

Không nhất quán về thì: khi thuật lại diễn biến của một câu chuyện trên phim, người bản xứ thường dùng thì hiện tại đơn (narrative present), nhưng thí sinh Việt Nam hay nhảy lộn xộn giữa quá khứ và hiện tại.

outlineVi: Mở đầu: Giới thiệu địa điểm đông đúc quen thuộc (Phố đi bộ Nguyễn Huệ tại TP.HCM) và vị trí đắc địa ngay trung tâm.
Ý 1: Mô tả đối tượng thường lui tới (giới trẻ, nghệ sĩ đường phố, các gia đình và du khách quốc tế) cùng tần suất bạn đến đây.

city.sample: A bustling location in my city that I know like the back of my hand is Nguyen Hue Pedestrian Street, situated right in the heart of District 1, Ho Chi Minh City. This vibrant promenade attracts an eclectic mix of people. On any given evening, you’ll see local teenagers hanging out, buskers showcasing their talents, and foreign tourists soaking up the nightlife. Families with young children also flock there to take leisurely strolls. People engage in a variety of activities here. Youngsters often gather to skate or record dance videos, while others pop into the trendy cafes housed in the famous vintage apartment building nearby. Food vendors dot the perimeter, offering popular street snacks like grilled rice paper. Personally, I have a love-hate relationship with this place. On the one hand, I’m drawn to its infectious energy, which makes it an ideal spot to unwind after a gruelling week. On the other hand, it gets packed to the rafters on weekends, and the sheer volume of noise can sometimes be overwhelming. Nevertheless, it remains the beating heart of the city.

p1.q: Do you live in a city or in the countryside?
p1.a: I currently live in a bustling city, specifically Hanoi. I really appreciate the convenience here because modern amenities like shopping malls and hospitals are virtually on my doorstep, even though the air quality can occasionally be a downside.

p1.q: What is your favourite place in your city?
p1.a: My go-to spot is definitely West Lake. It offers a peaceful escape from downtown noise, and I love cycling around the water at sunset while grabbing an iced coffee with friends to unwind.

p1.q: Is it easy to get around where you live?
p1.a: Generally, yes, because ride-hailing apps and bus routes are readily accessible and affordable. However, during rush hour, navigating the streets becomes a nightmare due to bumper-to-bumper traffic jams along major intersections.

p3.q: Will more people move to cities in the future?
p3.a: I believe urbanisation will definitely accelerate in the coming decades. Cities offer superior employment prospects, state-of-the-art healthcare, and premier educational institutions that rural areas simply lack. While living costs and housing shortages in metropolitan areas are rising steeply, the promise of higher living standards and career growth will continue to lure young professionals away from the countryside.

p3.q: How can cities reduce traffic jams?
p3.a: Governments should primarily invest heavily in comprehensive public transit networks, such as underground metro lines and electric buses, to make collective transport more enticing than private vehicles. Additionally, implementing congestion charges for cars entering central districts during peak hours could discourage unnecessary driving. Combining reliable infrastructure with financial disincentives is crucial to unclogging urban roads.

mistakesVi: Lạm dụng từ 'busy' hoặc 'crowded': Người học hay lặp lại các từ đơn giản này; nên thay bằng 'packed to the rafters', 'bustling', hoặc 'swarming with people'.
Dịch 'kẹt xe' theo kiểu tiếng Việt: Dùng sai thành 'have traffic jam' hoặc 'traffic is stuck'; cách diễn đạt chuẩn là 'get stuck in traffic' hoặc 'experience gridlock'.
Nhầm lẫn giữa 'convenient' và 'comfortable': Nhiều bạn nói 'City life is comfortable' khi muốn khen cuộc sống tiện nghi, dễ mua sắm, nhưng từ chính xác cần dùng là 'convenient'.

outlineVi: Mở đầu: Giới thiệu tên dự án 'Million Trees Vietnam' và mục đích chính là giảm bớt hiệu ứng đảo nhiệt đô thị.
Ý 1: Nêu địa điểm thực hiện (dọc các đại lộ, công viên, khu đất trống ở Hà Nội) và phương pháp chọn loại cây bản địa phù hợp.
Ý 2: Nêu rõ các thành phần tham gia như sinh viên tình nguyện, đoàn thanh niên địa phương và sự tài trợ của doanh nghiệp.
Kết: Giải thích hiệu quả kép của dự án: vừa hấp thụ khí CO2, tạo bóng mát vừa lan tỏa mạnh mẽ lối sống bền vững trong cộng đồng.
climate.sample: I’d like to talk about an urban reforestation initiative in my city called 'Million Trees Vietnam'. It was launched a couple of years ago to address deteriorating air quality and the urban heat island effect. Basically, the project involves planting native shade trees along major boulevards, public parks, and empty communal spaces across Hanoi. Before planting, organizers carefully survey local soil conditions to select species that thrive naturally and require minimal chemical fertilizers. What impresses me most is the community involvement. While non-profit groups coordinate the logistics, hundreds of student volunteers, local youth unions, and even neighborhood elders roll up their sleeves every weekend to dig holes and plant saplings. Private companies also sponsor tools and saplings as part of their social responsibility. I consider this campaign truly effective because it tackles climate change on multiple fronts. Beyond the obvious benefit of absorbing carbon dioxide and providing cooling shade during sweltering summers, it visibly raises eco-awareness among city dwellers. Seeing tangible green patches flourish right where they live inspires everyday citizens to adopt more sustainable lifestyles.

p1.q: Have you noticed any changes in the weather in your hometown recently?
p1.a: Definitely. In recent years, summers in Hanoi have become unbearably scorching, with heatwaves lasting for weeks. Just last July, daytime temperatures consistently exceeded forty degrees Celsius, which rarely happened during my childhood.

p1.q: What do you do in your daily life to protect the environment?
p1.a: I try to minimize single-use plastics by carrying my own canvas bag and stainless steel tumbler everywhere. Additionally, I commute to work by electric scooter rather than a petrol motorbike to cut down on emissions.

p1.q: Do you think schools should teach children about environmental issues?
p1.a: Yes, absolutely. Educating children early fosters eco-friendly habits, such as recycling and conserving water, from a young age. In my primary school, we organized regular clean-up days, which taught me the value of responsible waste disposal.

p3.q: Who should bear the primary responsibility for tackling global warming: individuals or governments?
p3.a: In my view, governments must lead the charge because systemic change requires enforceable regulations and major funding. While individual actions like recycling matter, only policymakers can introduce carbon taxes, mandate renewable energy transitions, and penalize polluting corporations. Without strict environmental laws, voluntary consumer efforts simply cannot offset industrial emissions at the necessary scale. Therefore, while citizens should play their part, state-level leadership remains the fundamental driver.

p3.q: How might technological advancements help reduce the impact of climate change in the future?
p3.a: Technological innovation holds immense potential, particularly in green energy and direct carbon capture. For instance, more efficient solar cells and next-generation battery storage can completely replace coal-fired power plants. However, technology alone isn't a silver bullet; these inventions must be economically viable and widely accessible to developing nations. Ultimately, combining breakthrough tech with political commitment offers our best chance to reverse ecological damage.

mistakesVi: Lạm dụng lặp lại từ 'climate change' hoặc 'environment' thay vì linh hoạt biến hóa sang 'global warming', 'ecological crisis', hoặc 'environmental degradation'.
Dịch từ ghép tiếng Việt sang tiếng Anh sai quy chuẩn collocation, ví dụ nói 'destroy the environment' quá chung chung thay vì 'wreak havoc on the ecosystem' hoặc 'take a heavy toll on nature'.
Dùng sai dạng danh từ không đếm được sang số nhiều, chẳng hạn nói 'many pollutions' hoặc 'plastic wastes' thay vì 'widespread pollution' hoặc 'plastic waste'.

outlineVi: Mở đầu: Giới thiệu trực tiếp món đồ đặc biệt (bộ vest may đo navy hoặc bộ áo dài lụa) và nguồn gốc (quà tốt nghiệp từ gia đình).
Ý 1 (Thiết kế & Nguồn gốc): Mô tả kiểu dáng hiện đại, chất liệu len pha thoáng mát hoặc lụa tơ tằm, cùng sự vừa vặn hoàn hảo từ thợ may.
Ý 2 (Dịp mặc & Tần suất): Liệt kê các dịp trang trọng như tiệc cưới, lễ tốt nghiệp, Tết, và nhấn mạnh tần suất hiếm hoi chỉ vài lần mỗi năm.
Kết (Cảm xúc & Lý do yêu thích): Giải thích sự tự tin, lịch lãm khi khoác lên mình và giá trị kỷ niệm vô giá từ tình cảm gia đình.
clothes.sample: I would like to talk about a tailor-made navy blue suit that I reserve exclusively for milestone celebrations. I received it as a university graduation gift from my parents two years ago, handcrafted by a reputable tailor in downtown Hanoi. Aesthetically, it boasts a sleek, modern cut crafted from breathable wool-blend fabric, featuring subtle satin lapels that add a touch of understated elegance. Unlike mass-produced off-the-rack garments, this suit fits like a glove and feels remarkably comfortable throughout long events. I generally slip into this suit on high-profile occasions, such as formal family weddings, high-stakes job interviews, and annual Tet banquets. Because it requires delicate dry cleaning, I only wear it perhaps three or four times each year. There are two primary reasons why I truly cherish this outfit. First, putting it on gives me an instant boost of confidence, helping me present myself with poise and maturity. More importantly, it holds immense sentimental value, constantly reminding me of my family's unwavering encouragement as I stepped out into the professional world.

p1.q: What kinds of clothes do you usually like to wear?
p1.a: I tend to gravitate towards casual and minimalist attire. On a typical day, I usually opt for breathable cotton T-shirts paired with relaxed-fit chinos, mainly because comfort is my top priority when commuting or working.

p1.q: Do you prefer shopping for clothes online or in physical stores?
p1.a: I definitely prefer brick-and-mortar shops. Being able to try garments on and feel the fabric firsthand prevents sizing blunders, like when I once bought an oversized jumper online that looked completely unflattering in real life.

p1.q: Did you have to wear a school uniform when you were younger?
p1.a: Yes, throughout my secondary school years, we were mandated to wear white button-downs and navy trousers. Although it felt somewhat rigid back then, it genuinely eliminated peer pressure regarding trendy branded clothes.

p3.q: Why do some people spend an excessive amount of money on designer brands?
p3.a: In my view, many individuals splurge on luxury fashion primarily to project social status and success. Wearing recognizable designer logos acts as a badge of prestige, boosting their self-esteem in social circles. While a minority might genuinely appreciate exceptional craftsmanship, the majority are driven by peer validation and materialism. Consequently, aggressive brand marketing capitalizes heavily on this desire to display wealth.

p3.q: How has the rise of fast fashion impacted the environment and consumer behavior?
p3.a: Fast fashion has drastically accelerated textile waste and environmental pollution through cheap, synthetic fabrics. Furthermore, it has cultivated an unhealthy throwaway culture among consumers, where garments are discarded after just a few wears rather than repaired. Although low prices democratize trendy clothing, the ecological consequences—ranging from microplastics to water contamination—are simply unsustainable. Therefore, embracing sustainable, circular fashion has become critical.

mistakesVi: Dùng sai ngữ pháp từ 'clothes': Từ này luôn ở dạng số nhiều và không có 'a clothe'. Để chỉ một chiếc áo/quần, phải dùng 'an item of clothing', 'a piece of clothing' hoặc 'a garment'.
Nhầm lẫn giữa 'wear', 'put on' và 'dress up': 'wear' chỉ trạng thái đang mặc đồ trên người, 'put on' là hành động mặc vào, còn 'dress up' là ăn mặc sang trọng/hóa trang.

Thiếu từ vựng miêu tả chất liệu và kiểu dáng: Học viên thường chỉ dùng tính từ mơ hồ như 'nice', 'good' thay vì các thuật ngữ ghi điểm như 'breathable', 'crease-resistant', 'loose-fitting' hay 'flattering'.

outlineVi: Mở đầu: Giới thiệu món thịt kho tàu (caramelised braised pork belly) cùng các nguyên liệu cốt lõi như thịt ba chỉ, nước dừa tươi và trứng luộc.
Ý 1: Người hướng dẫn và hoàn cảnh học: Mẹ dạy khi bắt đầu sống tự lập thời sinh viên, gắn liền với ký ức gia đình ấm cúng ngày Tết.
Ý 2: Các bước thực hiện: Ướp thịt ngấm gia vị, thắng đường tạo màu cánh gián, xào săn rồi ninh nhỏ lửa cùng nước dừa cho thịt mềm rục.
Kết: Lý do thích nấu: Quá trình nấu mang tính giải tỏa căng thẳng (therapeutic) và cảm giác hạnh phúc khi chia sẻ món ăn quê nhà nóng hổi cùng bạn bè.
cooking.sample: I’d like to talk about braised pork belly with eggs, a staple Vietnamese comfort food that I have mastered over the years. To prepare this savory dish, the essential ingredients include pork belly, quail or chicken eggs, shallots, garlic, fish sauce, and, crucially, fresh coconut water. I actually learned how to cook this from my mother when I first moved away for university. She taught me that the secret lies in balancing the sweet and savory notes properly. The preparation starts with cubing the pork and marinating it with minced aromatics and fish sauce. Then, I caramelize some sugar until it turns a deep amber color before tossing in the meat to brown. Next, I pour in fresh coconut water and let everything simmer on low heat for about an hour. Towards the end, I toss in the hard-boiled eggs so they absorb the rich, golden broth. I truly enjoy making this meal because it serves as therapeutic downtime after a hectic week. More importantly, seeing my friends savoring it with piping hot rice gives me a genuine sense of accomplishment and nostalgia.

p1.q: Do you often cook your own meals at home?
p1.a: Yes, I usually prepare my own meals on weekdays because it allows me to control the ingredients and eat healthily. For instance, last night I quickly stir-fried some vegetables and chicken breast after getting home from work.

p1.q: What was the very first dish you learned to make?
p1.a: If I recall correctly, it was a simple fried egg with spring onions. My mother taught me how to crack eggs properly and regulate the stove flame when I was just around ten years old.

p1.q: Do you prefer eating home-cooked food or dining out?
p1.a: I definitely lean towards home-cooked meals since they are far more wholesome and cost-effective. However, on busy weekends, I still treat myself to dinner at local restaurants to unwind with friends and try new cuisines.

p3.q: Should schools include culinary skills as a compulsory subject for young students?
p3.a: In my opinion, basic culinary training should definitely be part of the curriculum. Cooking is an indispensable life skill that fosters independence and helps youngsters make healthier dietary choices early on. Without these fundamental skills, many adolescents become overly reliant on processed fast food, which often leads to lifestyle-related health complications. Therefore, teaching children how to prepare simple, nutritious meals offers lifelong benefits.

p3.q: How has modern technology changed the way families prepare and consume food?
p3.a: Advancements in technology have fundamentally revolutionized domestic cooking. Modern appliances like air fryers and smart pressure cookers significantly cut down preparation time while promoting oil-free, healthier meals. Moreover, online recipe apps provide instant culinary inspiration for busy parents. Conversely, food delivery platforms sometimes discourage families from cooking together at all, which weakens communal bonding around the kitchen table. Overall, technology brings immense convenience despite reducing traditional culinary habits.

mistakesVi: Nhầm lẫn từ vựng 'cooker' và 'cook': Nhiều người nói nhầm 'My mother is a good cooker', trong khi 'cooker' là nồi/bếp nấu (như rice cooker), còn danh từ chỉ người nấu ăn là 'cook' hoặc 'chef'.
Lạm dụng từ 'delicious' và 'yummy': Thí sinh thường thiếu hụt các tính từ miêu tả chuyên sâu về mùi vị và kết cấu như 'savory' (đậm đà), 'tender' (mềm), 'crispy' (giòn) hay 'fragrant' (thơm phức).
Dịch vụng về từ tiếng Việt khi mô tả thao tác: Dùng 'put spices' thay vì các cụm tự nhiên như 'season the dish', 'marinate the meat' (ướp thịt) hay 'garnish with herbs' (rắc rau thơm trang trí).

outlineVi: Mở đầu: Giới thiệu tên lễ hội (Tết Nguyên Đán), vị thế quan trọng nhất trong văn hóa Việt và thời gian diễn ra (tháng Giêng âm lịch).
Ý 1: Nêu bối cảnh chuẩn bị đặc trưng trước Tết (dọn dẹp nhà cửa, trang trí hoa đào/hoa mai, mua sắm đồ thờ cúng).
Ý 2: Miêu tả các phong tục chính trong kỳ lễ (cúng tổ tiên với bánh chưng, xông đất, chúc Tết họ hàng và lì xì trẻ nhỏ).
Kết: Giải thích ý nghĩa thiêng liêng đối với bản thân (cơ hội sum họp gia đình, kết nối cội nguồn giữa nhịp sống hiện đại vội vã).
culture.sample: I would like to talk about the Lunar New Year, locally known as Tet, which is undoubtedly the most sacred festival in Vietnam. It takes place in late January or early February across the entire nation, marking the arrival of spring and a fresh beginning. In the run-up to the event, streets are bursting with vibrant peach blossoms and kumquat trees. Families spend days spring-cleaning their homes to sweep away misfortune. During the official days of Tet, people pay homage to their ancestors by offering traditional dishes like square glutinous rice cakes. We also visit relatives to exchange heartfelt blessings, while elders give children crisp banknotes in red envelopes for good fortune. This festival holds immense sentimental value for me because it serves as an irreplaceable family reunion. In our fast-paced society, my siblings and I work far from home, so Tet provides an opportunity to unwind, reconnect with loved ones, and bridge the generation gap. Ultimately, it reinforces my cultural identity and reminds me of my roots, no matter how much the world changes.

p1.q: Do you enjoy learning about traditions from other countries?
p1.a: Definitely, yes. I find foreign customs fascinating because they offer a fresh perspective on how different societies live. For instance, discovering Japanese tea ceremony rituals showed me how mindfully everyday actions can be performed.

p1.q: What is an important celebration in your hometown?
p1.a: Without a doubt, it is the Mid-Autumn Festival. Families gather under the full moon to share sweet mooncakes while children parade with colorful lanterns, creating a wonderfully vibrant community atmosphere throughout the neighborhood.

p1.q: Did your family have any special customs when you were growing up?
p1.a: Yes, we did. Every Sunday morning, my grandparents would gather all the children to prepare a communal breakfast together. It was a simple habit, but it taught us respect and mutual support from an early age.

p3.q: How has globalization affected the way younger generations view traditional customs?
p3.a: In my view, globalization has brought both opportunities and challenges. On the one hand, exposure to Western lifestyles sometimes makes youngsters consider local customs outdated or time-consuming. On the other hand, many young people now take pride in showcasing their distinct cultural heritage on global platforms like social media. Therefore, while modern integration may dilute certain rituals, it can also spark a renewed appreciation for indigenous roots.

p3.q: Do you think governments should invest public funds in preserving endangered cultural rituals?
p3.a: I wholeheartedly agree with this idea. Cultural rituals are the soul of a nation, carrying centuries of collective wisdom and historical values. If the state does not step in to financially subsidize intangible heritage, such as tribal chants or craft-making rituals, these practices will inevitably fade under commercial pressures. Thus, allocating budget to safeguard them is a crucial investment in national identity.

mistakesVi: Lạm dụng dịch 'Tet holiday' lặp đi lặp lại mà không linh hoạt sử dụng các từ thay thế học thuật như 'traditional spring festival' hay 'lunar new year celebration'.
Dịch nguyên văn tiếng Việt sang tiếng Anh thiếu tự nhiên (ví dụ: nói 'eat Tet' thay vì 'celebrate Tet', hoặc dùng 'lucky money' mà không diễn giải rõ ý niệm văn hóa).
Chỉ mô tả bề nổi hoạt động trong Part 3 như thể đang trả lời Part 1, quên đi việc bàn luận sâu về tác động xã hội, sự mai một văn hóa và tính bền vững.

daily-routine.sample:
I'd like to talk about a habit that has truly transformed my life: a brisk thirty-minute morning walk.

I adopted this routine about a year ago. Back then, I was constantly glued to my desk and felt utterly exhausted by midday. Realizing that I needed to shake things up, I bought a pair of running shoes and committed to waking up half an hour earlier every single day.

Nowadays, this activity fits seamlessly into my morning schedule. Right after getting out of bed at six, I put on my sneakers and head straight to a leafy park near my apartment. During this walk, I usually listen to an inspiring podcast or simply take in the crisp morning air before traffic gets chaotic. By seven, I am back home, refreshed and ready for breakfast.

This ritual is exceptionally beneficial to me for a couple of reasons. Physically, it gets my blood flowing and boosts my metabolism right off the bat. Mentally, it clears my head and sets a positive tone for the entire day. Without this routine, I genuinely feel sluggish and unproductive.

p1.q: What is the first thing you usually do after waking up?
p1.a: Generally, I drink a large glass of warm water right after getting out of bed. It instantly rehydrates my system and wakes up my brain, especially when I have an early morning study session.

p1.q: Do you prefer to do challenging tasks in the morning or in the evening?
p1.a: I definitely lean towards tackling demanding tasks early in the morning. My concentration is at its peak during those early hours, whereas by evening, mental fatigue usually sets in after a full day.

p1.q: Has your daily routine changed much compared to when you were younger?
p1.a: Yes, substantially. When I was a student, my schedule was quite spontaneous and flexible. Nowadays, due to work commitments, I have to stick strictly to structured timetables and set alarms every single day.

p3.q: Why do some people find it difficult to stick to a consistent daily schedule?
p3.a: In my view, unpredictable demands are the primary culprit. People often encounter urgent work deadlines or social commitments that derail their original plans. Additionally, many individuals lack self-discipline or set unrealistically rigid goals, which leads to early burnout. Consequently, when things go slightly off track, they abandon the schedule altogether instead of adapting flexibly.

p3.q: How has modern technology influenced the way people organize their day-to-day lives?
p3.a: Technology is undeniably a double-edged sword in this regard. On the positive side, digital calendars and productivity apps help individuals automate reminders and streamline daily commitments efficiently. However, constant notifications and social media feeds often disrupt focus, leading to severe procrastination. Therefore, while tools exist to optimize schedules, poor digital boundaries often shatter daily routines.

mistakesVi: Lỗi liệt kê thời gian máy móc: Thí sinh thường lặp lại các liên từ cơ bản như 'First', 'After that', 'And then' kèm mốc giờ cụ thể, khiến bài nói giống bản báo cáo thay vì dùng các cụm tự nhiên như 'Right after waking up' hay 'Once that is taken care of'.

Nhầm lẫn thì hiện tại tiếp diễn và hiện tại đơn: Thí sinh hay dùng sai thì tiếp diễn để nói về thói quen lặp đi lặp lại (ví dụ nói 'I am usually drinking coffee' thay vì chuẩn xác là 'I usually drink coffee').

Lạm dụng từ vựng dịch thô: Thí sinh hay dịch cụm 'giết thời gian' hoặc 'xả hơi' thành các câu rườm rà; thay vào đó nên dùng các phrasal verbs tự nhiên của người bản xứ như 'wind down', 'unwind' hoặc 'decompress'.

outlineVi: Mở đầu: Giới thiệu thực trạng ô nhiễm rác thải nhựa đáng báo động tại các khu chợ cóc quanh nơi mình sống.
Ý 1 (Giải pháp): Người dân chủ động đem theo túi vải, hộp đựng cá nhân và người bán thu thêm khoản phí nhỏ đối với túi nilon.
Ý 2 (Trách nhiệm): Cần sự phối hợp nhịp nhàng giữa chính quyền (ban hành chế tài) và từng hộ dân (thay đổi thói quen tiêu dùng).
Kết (Đánh giá): Khẳng định tính khả thi cao vì nhiều siêu thị lớn đã làm thành công và giải pháp này sẽ cắt giảm một nửa lượng rác khu phố.
environment.sample: In my neighbourhood in Hanoi, plastic waste has become a pressing issue. Everywhere you look, especially around traditional wet markets, discarded plastic bags and single-use containers are piling up, clogging drainage systems and spoiling the local landscape. To tackle this, I believe promoting reusable tote bags and food containers is the most practical solution. Shoppers could simply bring their own canvas bags and multi-use boxes instead of grabbing handfuls of flimsy plastic bags from vendors. At the same time, shopkeepers should charge a small nominal fee for every plastic bag provided, which immediately discourages careless usage. Regarding responsibility, it has to be a joint effort. Local authorities need to run awareness campaigns and enforce bag fees, but ultimately, residents themselves must change their mindset and break away from this throwaway culture. I'm confident this approach would work wonders. Supermarkets in my city have already started charging for carrier bags, and people adapted remarkably quickly. If local markets do the same, we could cut neighbourhood waste by half within a year.

p1.q: Is the environment important to you?
p1.a: Absolutely, it's vital to me because our well-being directly depends on it. Breathing polluted air or drinking contaminated water ruins our health, so I believe keeping our surroundings clean ensures a much higher quality of life for everyone.

p1.q: What do you do to protect the environment?
p1.a: I try to minimize my carbon footprint by commuting via public transit or cycling instead of riding a motorbike. Additionally, I always carry a refillable water bottle and avoid single-use plastics whenever I go grocery shopping.

p1.q: Is there an environmental problem where you live?
p1.a: Yes, urban air pollution is a major headache in my city. Heavy traffic congestion and endless construction projects generate thick dust and toxic exhaust fumes, which often trigger respiratory issues for local residents like myself.

p3.q: Should governments or individuals take more responsibility for the environment?
p3.a: I believe both play crucial roles, but governments should lead the way. Authorities have the legislative power to enforce strict emissions standards and invest in renewable energy infrastructure, which individuals simply cannot do alone. That being said, top-down policies will only bear fruit if citizens actively sort their waste and adopt greener lifestyles. In essence, state regulations provide the framework, while individual actions drive genuine change.

p3.q: How can schools teach children to care for the environment?
p3.a: Schools can make environmental education hands-on rather than purely theoretical. For instance, teachers can organize regular campus clean-ups or guide pupils in maintaining a school vegetable garden and composting food scraps. When youngsters witness the direct impact of conservation firsthand, it resonates far deeper than textbook lectures. This practical exposure helps instill lifelong sustainable habits from an early age.

mistakesVi: Lạm dụng cụm từ 'protect the environment' quá nhiều lần thay vì biến hóa bằng các cách diễn đạt tương đương như 'reduce carbon footprint', 'preserve natural habitats', hay 'curb pollution'.
Dùng sai danh từ không đếm được 'rubbish/garbage/waste' (người học hay thêm 's' thành *wastes* hoặc dùng sai động từ như *drop litters* thay vì *litter* hoặc *drop litter*).
Dịch từng từ tiếng Việt sang tiếng Anh khi diễn đạt việc phân loại rác, chẳng hạn dùng *divide garbage* thay vì collocation tự nhiên là *sort waste* hoặc *separate trash at source*.

outlineVi: Mở đầu: Giới thiệu người có tầm ảnh hưởng lớn nhất đối với bạn (ví dụ: ông nội) và mối quan hệ khăng khít từ thuở thơ ấu.
Ý 1 (Mối quan hệ & Bối cảnh): Giải thích bạn hiểu rõ người này thế nào qua việc sống chung nhà và quan sát thói quen sinh hoạt hàng ngày của họ.
Ý 2 (Bài học được dạy): Chia sẻ cụ thể bài học quý giá họ đã dạy (cách đối mặt với thất bại, lòng bao dung, làm gương bằng hành động).
Kết: Khẳng định sự ảnh hưởng sâu sắc của người đó đến thế giới quan, tính cách và cách bạn đưa ra quyết định khi trưởng thành.
family.sample:
I'd like to talk about my maternal grandfather, who has undoubtedly had the most profound impact on my life. Having lived with him throughout my formative years, I had the privilege of observing his daily habits and worldview up close.

He was a retired teacher, known for his calm temperament and boundless curiosity. What he taught me goes far beyond academics; he instilled in me the importance of resilience and empathy. Whenever I faced setbacks at school, he never reprimanded me. Instead, he would patiently explain that failure is simply a stepping stone to growth. He truly led by example, treating everyone around him with unwavering kindness, regardless of their social standing.

His influence has shaped who I am today in countless ways. Because of him, I developed a lifelong passion for reading and a habit of looking at problems from multiple perspectives. Whenever I encounter dilemmas in my adult life, I still ask myself what he would do in that situation, which keeps me grounded and focused on what truly matters.

p1.q: How many people are there in your family?
p1.a: There are four of us: my parents, my younger sister, and me. We are a fairly small, nuclear family, and we always try to catch up over home-cooked dinners every evening.

p1.q: Do you live with your family?
p1.a: Yes, I currently share an apartment with my parents in Hanoi. Living together allows us to support each other with daily chores and maintain a close emotional bond while saving on living expenses.

p1.q: Do you spend much time with your relatives?
p1.a: Not as much as I would like, primarily because most of my uncles and cousins live in the countryside. However, we always make a point of gathering together during major holidays like Tet.

p3.q: Do families spend enough time together nowadays?
p3.a: In my view, many families struggle to spend meaningful quality time together nowadays. With demanding work schedules and the ubiquitous presence of digital devices, family members often sit in the same room while remaining glued to their smartphones. For instance, shared conversations are frequently displaced by social media scrolling. Consequently, emotional intimacy can gradually weaken unless households make a deliberate effort to disconnect from screens and engage with one another.

p3.q: How have family structures changed in your country?
p3.a: In Vietnam, there has been a marked transition from traditional multi-generational households to nuclear families. Decades ago, it was customary for three generations to reside under the same roof. However, rapid urbanization and an increasing desire for privacy have prompted young couples to purchase their own flats in urban centers. While this fosters greater personal autonomy, it sometimes diminishes the immediate daily support system that extended families historically provided.

mistakesVi: Dịch nguyên chữ từ tiếng Việt sang câu gượng gạo như 'My family has 4 people' thay vì cấu trúc tự nhiên 'There are four of us in my family' hoặc 'I come from a family of four'.
Nhầm lẫn nghiêm trọng giữa 'grow up' (nội động từ: tự lớn lên) và 'raise / bring up' (ngoại động từ: nuôi nấng), ví dụ nói sai 'My parents grew me up' thay vì 'My parents raised me'.
Lạm dụng từ 'family' lặp đi lặp lại liên tục thay vì linh hoạt biến hóa bằng các từ đồng nghĩa ngữ cảnh như 'household', 'nuclear family', 'loved ones', hay 'relatives'.

Ý 2: Các hoạt động cụ thể đã tham gia (thả hoa đăng trên sông Thu Bồn, thưởng thức bánh nướng và xem múa lân).
Kết: Giải thích lý do khó quên (sự ấm áp từ tình thân, cảm giác bình yên và sự kết nối cội nguồn sâu sắc).
festivals.sample:
I would like to share my experience at the Mid-Autumn Lantern Festival in Hoi An, which I attended two years ago. I traveled there with two of my closest university friends right in the middle of the lunar eighth month, when the ancient town switched off all fluorescent streetlights.

The entire riverside was illuminated by thousands of colorful, handcrafted silk lanterns. We spent the evening weaving through bustling alleyways, watching energetic lion dances, and sampling traditional baked mooncakes sold by street vendors. Later on, we hired a wooden boat to gently drift down the Thu Bon River and released glowing paper lanterns into the water while making personal wishes.

What made this experience unforgettable was the enchanting ambience and the profound sense of harmony. In our fast-paced modern routines, we rarely pause to appreciate intangible cultural heritage. Being immersed in that warm, golden glow alongside locals and travelers gave me a deep feeling of tranquility and renewed my appreciation for longstanding Vietnamese customs.

p1.q: What is your favorite traditional festival in your country?
p1.a: Without a doubt, Tet or the Lunar New Year is my absolute favorite. It is an invaluable occasion when all family members gather around a warm dinner table, exchange heartfelt wishes, and enjoy customary dishes like Chung cake.

p1.q: How do people usually celebrate public holidays where you live?
p1.a: Most urban residents take advantage of these breaks to travel or meet up with friends. For instance, during National Day, people often flock to pedestrian zones to watch outdoor music concerts and magnificent fireworks.

p1.q: Do you prefer spending festival times with your family or friends?
p1.a: I generally gravitate towards family gatherings for traditional events because they carry nostalgic rituals. However, for modern festivities like New Year's Eve, I prefer counting down with close friends at vibrant street parties.

p3.q: In what ways do commercial promotions alter the traditional essence of cultural festivals?
p3.a: Mass marketing often shifts the focus from spiritual introspection or familial bonding toward relentless consumerism. When holidays become dominated by shopping sprees, festive sales, and superficial packaging, their historical narratives get eclipsed. For instance, Mid-Autumn Festival in urban areas has evolved from an intimate folk reunion into a cutthroat corporate gifting competition, diluting the original values of togetherness and gratitude.

p3.q: Why might younger generations feel less connected to ancient customs and folk celebrations?
p3.a: A major reason is the pervasive influence of globalization and digital entertainment, which presents youth with endless modern distractions. Furthermore, many ancestral ceremonies involve archaic and repetitive formalities that young adults struggle to identify with. Unless these traditions are actively revitalized and contextualized in engaging, modern formats—such as interactive cultural festivals—the generational divide will inevitably widen, leaving young people detached from their cultural roots.

mistakesVi: Lạm dụng danh từ 'festival' lặp đi lặp lại thay vì linh hoạt biến đổi bằng các cụm từ tương đương như 'cultural celebration', 'festive occasion', 'public holiday' hoặc 'commemoration'.
Dịch từng từ từ tiếng Việt sang tiếng Anh dẫn đến cách diễn đạt thiếu tự nhiên, ví dụ nói 'play festival' thay vì dùng động từ chuẩn như 'celebrate a festival' hay 'partake in festivities'.
Dùng sai giới từ chỉ thời gian cho các dịp lễ, ví dụ dùng 'in Tet' thay vì cách nói chuẩn xác là 'at Tet' hoặc 'during the Tet holiday'.

outlineVi: Mở đầu: Giới thiệu trực tiếp món phở bò truyền thống và vị trí đặc biệt của nó trong nền ẩm thực Việt Nam.
Ý 1 (Nguyên liệu & Cách nấu): Nêu các thành phần cốt lõi (bánh phở, thịt bò tái/nạm) và quy trình hầm xương ống cùng thảo mộc để tạo nên nước dùng thanh ngọt.
Ý 2 (Thời điểm thưởng thức): Nhắc đến việc món này phổ biến nhất vào bữa sáng nhưng có thể ăn cả ngày, nhất là vào tiết trời se lạnh.
Kết (Cảm nhận cá nhân): Bày tỏ niềm yêu thích nhờ sự hòa quyện hương vị tinh tế cùng cảm giác hoài niệm, gắn kết gia đình.
food.sample:
I would like to talk about Phở bò, which is undoubtedly the most iconic traditional dish from Vietnam.

At its core, this dish consists of delicate, flat rice noodles served in a piping-hot, aromatic broth and topped with tender cuts of beef, along with fresh scallions and coriander. The true magic lies in the broth, which is patiently simmered for hours using beef marrow bones, charred ginger, star anise, and cinnamon to achieve an extraordinarily rich, savory depth of flavor.

Traditionally, Vietnamese people savor a bowl of Pho for breakfast to kick-start their day, but nowadays it is enjoyed around the clock, from quick lunches to late-night suppers. It is particularly satisfying on chilly mornings or rainy evenings when that steaming soup warms you from the inside out.

The main reason I adore Pho is its remarkable balance of flavors and textures. It feels nourishing and light rather than greasy, and every single spoonful offers a wonderful sense of nostalgia, reminding me of cozy weekend breakfasts with my grandparents. It is truly the ultimate comfort food.

p1.q: What kind of food do you enjoy most?
p1.a: I am particularly fond of home-cooked Vietnamese meals. I appreciate dishes featuring balanced flavors and plenty of fresh greens, such as sweet and sour fish soup, because they are wholesome and never feel heavy or greasy.

p1.q: Do you enjoy cooking?
p1.a: Yes, absolutely. Preparing meals is a therapeutic way for me to unwind after a stressful day. I genuinely love experimenting with fresh herbs and spices, and whipping up a delicious dinner gives me a great sense of satisfaction.

p1.q: Do you prefer eating at home or in restaurants?
p1.a: I generally prefer eating at home because it is far healthier and budget-friendly. However, on weekends, I do occasionally eat out with friends to try diverse international cuisines, like Japanese sushi or authentic Italian pasta.

p3.q: Is fast food a problem in your country?
p3.a: Yes, it is increasingly becoming a serious public health concern, especially among young people in metropolitan areas. Due to hectic work routines, many individuals regularly consume burgers, fried chicken, and sugary drinks. This regular reliance on processed meals has contributed significantly to alarming spikes in childhood obesity, diabetes, and cardiovascular complications across modern cities.

p3.q: How has the way people eat changed over the last few decades?
p3.a: In the past, families almost exclusively gathered for home-cooked meals prepared with fresh ingredients bought daily from wet markets. In contrast, modern dining revolves heavily around speed and convenience. The widespread popularity of food delivery apps and ready-to-eat convenience store meals means people often eat on the go, which unfortunately undermines communal family dining traditions and nutritional balance.

mistakesVi: Lạm dụng quá mức từ 'delicious' khi miêu tả món ăn; nên linh hoạt dùng 'savory', 'mouth-watering', 'flavorful', hoặc 'tantalizing' để bài nói phong phú hơn.
Nhầm lẫn giữa danh từ không đếm được 'food' (nói chung) và danh từ đếm được 'foods' (các nhóm hoặc loại thực phẩm cụ thể, như 'processed foods').
Dịch từ ngữ một cách gượng gạo từ tiếng Việt, ví dụ nói 'eat delicious' thay vì 'it tastes delicious', hoặc dùng 'cook myself' thay vì 'cook for myself / cook on my own'.

friends.sample:
I would like to talk about Minh, my closest friend from university. We first met during our freshman orientation week and hit it off almost immediately thanks to our shared love for badminton.

A couple of years ago, I went through a very rough patch when I failed a crucial semester exam while juggling a stressful part-time job. I was on the verge of burning out and seriously contemplated dropping out. Minh noticed I was unusually withdrawn and stepped in without hesitation. Not only did he lend a sympathetic ear when I vented my frustrations, but he also created a structured study plan for me. Every evening for three straight weeks, he patiently walked me through complex accounting concepts and tested my revision.

His generous support bailed me out of academic probation, but more importantly, it restored my shattered self-confidence. I felt deeply indebted and profoundly grateful for his unwavering patience. Knowing that someone believed in me when I doubted myself meant the world. That experience cemented our bond, proving to me that true friends truly stick together through thick and thin.

p1.q: Do you have a close friend?
p1.a: Yes, definitely. My childhood friend Nam has been my confidant for over a decade. We share almost everything from daily trivial gossip to major career plans, and he always supports me whenever I face dilemmas.

p1.q: How often do you meet your friends?
p1.a: I try to catch up with them at least once or twice a week. We usually hang out at a local café on weekends to unwind, chat about our work, and blow off some steam together.

p1.q: Do you prefer meeting friends in person or online?
p1.a: I certainly prefer meeting in person because physical presence allows for genuine emotional connection. You can read body language and share laughs over a meal, whereas texting or video calls often feel somewhat detached.

p3.q: Is it harder to make close friends as an adult?
p3.a: I firmly believe it is. When we are young, shared environments like school create effortless opportunities to bond. As adults, however, people are constrained by heavy workloads and family duties, leaving little spare time. Furthermore, adults naturally become more guarded and cautious about opening up emotionally compared to carefree children. Therefore, cultivating deep, authentic bonds in adulthood demands substantially more intentional effort.

p3.q: Can online friendships be as strong as real-life ones?
p3.a: In my view, while online friendships can be remarkably supportive, they rarely match the depth of real-world relationships. Virtual communication allows people to connect over niche interests regardless of distance, which is wonderful. However, without experiencing shared physical realities and weathering real-life crises side by side, it is harder to build rock-solid trust. Thus, face-to-face interactions still provide a stronger foundation for lifelong camaraderie.

mistakesVi: Dịch chay từ tiếng Việt 'chơi với bạn' thành 'play with my friends' khi nói về người lớn; nên dùng 'hang out with', 'spend time with' hoặc 'keep company with'.
Quên chia số nhiều trong cụm 'make friends with someone' (thường nói sai thành 'make friend').
Nhầm lẫn từ loại giữa tính từ 'friendly' (thân thiện) và danh từ 'friendship' (tình bạn), dẫn đến lỗi như 'We have a good friendly'.

outlineVi: Mở đầu: Giới thiệu địa điểm ghé thăm (ví dụ Vườn bách thảo Đà Lạt) và thời điểm cùng người đồng hành.
Ý 1: Miêu tả địa hình, quy mô và thảm thực vật nổi bật (các luống hoa cẩm tú cầu nở rộ, đồi thông cổ thụ, nhà kính xương rồng).
Ý 2: Trình bày các hoạt động đã làm (tản bộ trên lối đi lát đá, chụp ảnh lưu niệm, ngồi hít thở không khí trong lành).
Kết: Nêu lý do gây ấn tượng mạnh (tác dụng giải tỏa căng thẳng sau chuỗi ngày ở đô thị, khơi dậy niềm đam mê chăm sóc cây cỏ).
gardens.sample: I would like to talk about the botanical garden in Da Lat that I visited last spring with a close friend. It is nestled right near the city centre, surrounded by rolling hills. The garden was breathtaking, filled with lush greenery and diverse indigenous flora. I saw vibrant beds of hydrangeas in full bloom, towering pine trees offering soothing shade, and a massive greenhouse packed with rare orchids and desert succulents. During our visit, we spent hours meandering down stone pathways, taking snapshots of exotic flowers, and simply sitting on a wooden bench to breathe in the crisp, floral-scented air. What made this visit truly unforgettable was how incredibly peaceful it felt. Living in a bustling concrete jungle, I rarely get the chance to slow down, so immersing myself in that tranquil sanctuary was like a breath of fresh air. It had an immediate therapeutic effect on my stressed mind and sparked my genuine appreciation for botanical conservation.

p1.q: Do you have any potted plants or flowers in your home?
p1.a: Yes, I keep a few small succulents and a money plant on my windowsill. They do not require frequent watering, and having that touch of green really brightens up my living space after a long day.

p1.q: Did you enjoy visiting public gardens when you were a child?
p1.a: Definitely. My parents used to take me to the municipal flower park on weekends. I was fascinated by the colourful blossoms and loved chasing dragonflies across the spacious lawns with my siblings.

p1.q: Would you like to grow your own vegetables in the future?
p1.a: I certainly would. Having a small rooftop vegetable patch would allow me to harvest fresh organic herbs like basil and mint, which are much safer and taste far better than store-bought produce.

p3.q: Why do many urban residents find it important to maintain green spaces in modern cities?
p3.a: In fast-paced metropolitan areas, green spaces serve as vital sanctuaries. They act as natural air purifiers, absorbing carbon dioxide and mitigating urban heat. Furthermore, spending time amidst trees and flower beds offers people an emotional refuge from daily workplace pressures. Without these green lungs, concrete jungles can feel suffocating and contribute significantly to mental exhaustion, which is why preserving public parks has become indispensable for urban well-being.

p3.q: How might children benefit from participating in gardening activities at school?
p3.a: Engaging in gardening fosters a strong sense of responsibility and patience among young learners. When children plant seeds and tend to them daily, they understand where food comes from and gain respect for nature. Unlike passive classroom learning, getting their hands dirty provides tactile experiences that stimulate scientific curiosity. Ultimately, this hands-on involvement nurtures environmental awareness from an early age, helping them develop into more eco-conscious adults.

mistakesVi: Dùng từ 'tree' hoặc 'flower' lặp đi lặp lại thay vì linh hoạt biến hóa với các thuật ngữ chính xác như 'houseplants', 'succulents', 'foliage', hay 'botanical species'.
Dịch thô cụm từ 'trồng cây' thành 'grow tree' thay vì dùng chuẩn xác 'plant trees' (hành động hạ giống) hoặc 'grow/cultivate plants' (quá trình chăm bón để cây phát triển).
Nhầm lẫn giới từ trong cụm từ kết nối với thiên nhiên, thường nói 'connect to nature' thay vì cấu trúc tự nhiên hơn trong văn nói là 'connect with nature' hoặc 'commune with nature'.

outlineVi: Mở đầu: Giới thiệu người gửi (bạn thân thời thơ ấu), dịp nhận (sinh nhật lần thứ 24) và cảm xúc bất ngờ khi thấy bì thư trong hòm thư.
Ý 1 (Who & Where/When): Chi tiết về hoàn cảnh nhận tại nhà riêng vào một buổi chiều sau giờ làm việc bận rộn; nêu bật sự đối lập với tin nhắn điện thoại thông thường.
Ý 2 (Content): Tóm lược nội dung lá thư dài hai trang (kể lại kỷ niệm ngây ngô thời học sinh, động viên khi mình chuyển việc, nét mực có đoạn vội vã chân thật).
Kết (Why special): Giải thích lý do đặc biệt (sự kiên nhẫn khi 'put pen to paper', tấm lòng chân thành không thể thay thế bởi văn bản gõ phím, trở thành kỷ vật quý giá).
handwriting.sample: I would like to talk about a handwritten birthday card I received from my childhood best friend, Linh, about two years ago. It arrived in my mailbox right on my twenty-fourth birthday, completely out of the blue. Nowadays, people almost exclusively send quick emoji-filled texts on messaging apps, so holding a physical envelope with my name penned in familiar, slightly messy ink was genuinely heartwarming. Inside, she had written a two-page letter reflecting on our ten-year friendship. She recalled hilarious blunders from our high school days, acknowledged how tough my recent job transition had been, and offered sincere words of encouragement. You could actually see where her handwriting accelerated when she got excited and where she hesitated, which made the message come alive. What made this card truly irreplaceable was the deliberate effort behind it. In this fast-paced digital era, typing a generic greeting takes seconds, but putting pen to paper requires real mindfulness and patience. It proved that she took time out of her hectic schedule to craft something tangible. I still keep that card tucked safely inside my favorite book as a treasured keepsake.

p1.q: Do you prefer writing by hand or typing on a keyboard?
p1.a: I definitely lean towards typing because it is significantly faster and allows for effortless editing. When drafting complex work reports, using a mechanical keyboard boosts my daily productivity, though I still use pen and paper for creative brainstorming.

p1.q: When was the last time you wrote something by hand?
p1.a: Just yesterday morning, actually. I quickly scrawled down a grocery shopping list on a sticky note before leaving for the market, as holding a paper slip feels much more convenient than constantly unlocking my phone in crowded aisles.

p1.q: Do you think handwriting will still be important in the future?
p1.a: Yes, absolutely. While digital typing dominates professional correspondence, handwriting retains immense legal and sentimental value, such as signing binding contracts or penning heartfelt greeting cards that generic computer fonts can never truly substitute.

p3.q: In what situations do people still prefer handwriting over digital typing?
p3.a: People generally favor handwriting in formal legal transactions or deeply sentimental contexts. For instance, signing official certificates or endorsing marriage registers demands physical ink to establish authenticity. Furthermore, sending handwritten sympathy or wedding notes conveys genuine warmth and emotional investment that a typed message completely lacks. Whenever personal intimacy or legal irrevocability is essential, penmanship remains unmatched.

p3.q: Should primary schools allocate more curriculum time to keyboard skills than penmanship?
p3.a: I believe educational institutions should strike a sensible balance rather than discard penmanship altogether. While touch typing is undeniably essential for modern workplace competence, early handwriting fosters fine motor control and deepens cognitive processing in young learners. Therefore, schools ought to teach foundational keyboarding skills alongside traditional cursive, ensuring students develop practical technological agility without compromising brain development.

mistakesVi: Lạm dụng từ 'handwrite' như một động từ chia thông thường; nên dùng cụm động từ tự nhiên như 'write by hand' hoặc dùng phân từ 'handwritten' làm tính từ bổ nghĩa cho danh từ.
Nhầm lẫn giới từ khi nói về phương tiện viết và gõ, chẳng hạn nói sai 'type by keyboard' thay vì chuẩn xác là 'type on a keyboard' hoặc 'write with a pen'.
Thiếu từ vựng mô tả tính chất chữ viết (như 'legible', 'messy scrawl', 'penmanship'), khiến thí sinh liên tục lặp lại các từ cơ bản như 'write beautifully' hoặc 'bad writing'.
